call.title: Video interview
call.lead: Tap the button to join the call with our recruiter.
call.notActiveText: This call has already ended or the link is not valid. Please contact us.
call.cameraText: Allow camera and microphone for this page in your browser settings, then try again.
call.hintIos: On iPhone: tap “aA” in the address bar → Website Settings → Camera → Allow.
call.hintOther: In Chrome: tap the icon left of the address → Permissions → Camera → Allow.
call.errorText: Check your internet connection and try again.
admin.title: Video calls
admin.lead: Create a room and send the link to the candidate. Every room stays open for 30 minutes.
admin.empty: No active meetings. Create one above.
admin.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
